_note: Adafruit Circuit Playground Express (ATSAMD21G18). Its 14 alligator pads: A0-A7, two 3.3V, three GND and VOUT. Terminal names are MakeCode's pins.A0..A7 lowercased. Functions follow pxt-adafruit 1.6.8's own pin typing (device.d.ts): A0 is the true-analog DAC output (AnalogOutPin) and is also the speaker line; A1/A2 are PwmPin; A3-A7 are AnalogInPin (the hardware can PWM more of them; MakeCode does not expose it); A1-A7 are capacitive touch; A4/A5 are I2C SCL/SDA and A6/A7 UART RX/TX. The second 3.3V pad is 3v3_2 and the GND pads gnd/gnd2/gnd3 (engine names). VOUT is USB 5V or the battery, whichever is higher, after the power-path diode. The ten NeoPixels, buttons A/B, slide switch, speaker, microphone, light/temperature/motion sensors and IR are part of the board, not pads. Face: pxt-adafruit's simulator board art (MIT), see ART-PROVENANCE.md; x/y are the pad centres in that art scaled by 0.62, which draws the board at 50.6 mm across — its real 2-inch (50.8 mm) diameter to within 0.3%.
